title: Choose how the Media library is laid out
question: Three ways to add folders to the Media page, all in the admin panel's look. Pick one to build, steer it, or ask for another three.

options.label: Two shelves
options.lineage: shared drives with a staff side and an app side
options.thesis: Staff files and the app's files are two shelves you switch between; inside each, breadcrumbs and folder tiles above a picture grid.
options.viewport: Title band with search; a Library / Made by the app switch; breadcrumbs; a row of folder tiles; the picture grid; a tray docks at the foot when files are chosen, with Move to.
options.risk: No tree: deep folders are only reachable one level at a time.

options.label: Folder tree beside the grid
options.thesis: A sand folder tree on the left (staff folders, then a locked Made by the app section), the grid in the middle, the chosen file's detail on the right.
options.viewport: Tree column 240px with drop targets; breadcrumb, search, filters and grid/list switch over the grid; detail pane with Move to and Used in.
options.risk: Three columns beside the navy sidebar is dense under 1280px; the tree collapses there.

options.label: Outline table
options.thesis: One sortable table where folders open in place to show their files, indented, with the detail pane beside it, as the library works today.
options.viewport: Toolbar with search and filters; folder rows with chevrons and counts, files indented under open folders; locked app folders at the foot; detail pane right.
options.risk: Pictures are small rows, so finding one by eye is slower than a grid.
